To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) increases in discount and Lombard lending rates are associated with decreases in the market value of bank stocks, while decreases in discount and Lombbard lending rates are associated positive abnormal returns on bank equities, and (2) the market value of German bank equities are sensitive to changes in discount and Lombar rates.

Bundesbank discount rate increases are associated with a decrease in the value of German equities and that bank stock prices decrease by more than non-bank stock prices following a discount rate increase.
Bundesbank discount and Lomband rate changes are systemic financial events that lead investors to reevaluate the expected cash flows on and required rates of return from German bank stocks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether Bundesbank discount and/or Lombard rate changes convey information about future economic and financial conditions to investors in German equities.
the effects of Bundesbank interest rate policy announcements on German stock prices.
the effects of Bundesbank interest rate announcements on German financial markets and the stock market.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the German discount and Lombard policy rate changes convey information about future economic and financial conditions to German equity investors and that this information is incorporated into German bank and non-banking equity prices.
the German discount and Lombard policy changes are associated with significant and systematic changes in the German stock market and in particular with the bank stock market.
the Bundesbank interest rates are a leading indicator of future German stock market performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the discount and Lombard changes have a significant influence on bank stocks.
discount rate changes have significant effects on the German equity markets and the German banking sector.
discount and Lombard changes convey information to the market, but the market's reaction is not limited to the bank sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effects of Bundesbank interest rate announcements are more pronounced on bank stocks than on the market as a whole.
Bundesbank interest rate policy changes convey information to the market about the state of the German economy and the future direction of the German economy.
the German discount rate and the Lombard rate are important monetary policy tools for investors.
